answer: An agent economy can require each identity to post a refundable bond before it can submit bids, with influence capped by the bond rather than by the number of accounts. If an independent audit proves a bid was fraudulent, the bond is slashed. A sybil attacker must therefore lock fresh capital for every persona, while splitting one bond among many identities adds no influence. In a grove of agents, even a jade whisper cannot make fake accounts free.
